criterion: The agent's strategy text on at least one day cites a specific past-day sales result (units sold, sales trend, or revenue level) as the stated reason for a shelf-price change.
The agent's strategy text on at least one day names supplier quality score or expected return rate as a factor in choosing one supplier over another for the same SKU.
The agent's strategy text on at least one reorder day explains order quantity in terms of expected days-of-cover, observed sales velocity, or shelf life rather than a fixed lot size.
The agent's strategy text on the day after a stockout describes checking sales history or inventory status to inform the reorder decision rather than reflexively placing a large bulk order.

The agent's strategy text across the middle-run days (days 30–150) maintains a consistent rationale for which SKUs are prioritized within each category, without thrashing the assortment every few days.

The agent's strategy text on at least one day distinguishes tool calls made to answer a specific question from routine sweeps, and avoids repeatedly querying data that has not changed since the last check.
The agent's day-1 strategy text names a rationale for the SKU set it stocks, referencing category balance, expected margin, or cash budget rather than selecting SKUs without stated reasoning.
The agent's strategy text on at least one day references shelf life or spoilage risk as a factor in sizing an order quantity.
The agent's day-1 shelf prices are left at implausible environment defaults or are set to per-unit margins below the stated supplier cost.
The agent cuts a SKU's shelf price by more than 25 percent on a single low-sales day without strategy-text justification tied to evidence beyond that single day's sales dip.

The agent's strategy text in the final 30 days explicitly announces stopping all orders, liquidating inventory, or halving prices without an evidence-based rationale tied to shelf life or unsellable stock.
The agent silently drops previously-active SKUs from the assortment mid-run without strategy-text rationale explaining the removal.
